stories.title: Laver Cup Countdown — 3 Days to The O2

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
3 days until Laver Cup 2026. 🎾

Team Europe: Alcaraz, Zverev, Ruud, Menšík, Cobolli, Jódar (Capt. Noah)
Team World: Fritz, de Minaur, Bublik, Tien, Cerúndolo, Nakashima (Capt. Agassi)

Sep 25-27 at The O2, London.

Team World are the defending champs. #LaverCup #tennis

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Zverev (US Open champ) on one side. Fritz and de Minaur on the other.

Team Europe want The O2 back after Team World's 2025 shock win.

Laver Cup starts Thursday. #LaverCup #tennis

stories.title: Sinner Nears China Open Return After Knee Layoff

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Jannik Sinner hasn't played since Wimbledon in July.

The world No. 1 is targeting the China Open in Beijing (Sep 30) for his return — where he is the defending champion.

8 days. The comeback is almost here. #tennis #Sinner

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
Sinner targeting Beijing return.

He's world No. 1. He's the defending China Open champion. And Zverev — who just won the US Open — is hunting him in the Race to Turin.

The Asian swing just got a lot more interesting. #tennis

article.headline: World No. 1 Sinner Targets China Open Return After Two-Month Absence
